program: Verve N Veda / Khaemenes Academy Beta Program

spyders.name: Sentinel Spyder
spyders.role: Observe approved Beta public surfaces for availability, Beta doorway presence, expected assets, redirects and page-level integrity signals.

spyders.name: Repo Spyder
spyders.role: Observe approved Beta-participating repositories for release, workflow, manifest and known-good reference drift through authorized repository integrations.

spyders.name: Beta Spyder
spyders.role: Lead Beta child. Correlate explicit Beta participation signals, user-shared report metadata and page failure indicators without silently collecting report text or learner data.

spyders.name: Recovery Spyder
spyders.role: Observe sanitized continuity and recovery-readiness metadata for Beta-participating surfaces without accessing recovery secrets.

spyders.name: Directory Spyder
spyders.role: Compare the approved Beta surface inventory with current public participation and report missing, stale or unexpected entries.
